Following the [[Mandalorian Excision|war]] led by a [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]]-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] Coalition against the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], and the decline of the Mandalorian ways following the [[Mandalorian Excision]], '''Aka'liit''' (or the '''Mandalorian Faithful''' in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]) was formed by those within the Mandalorians whom desired to stay true to their warrior past.

The Faithful created a secret network of clan representatives, passing down the [[Resol'nare]] and Mandalorian history to their children. Within a generation, the Faithful appointed the first in their line of '[[Mandalore (title)/Legends|True Mandalores]]', whom they offered their allegiance to secretly. The Faithful referred to this time as ''ba'slan shev'la'', choosing to disappear and prepare for an opportunity to strike back against the Faithless, calling their warriors Alor'a Aka'liit (the Vanguard of the Faithful.)

In [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]], the Faithful began to consider the machinations of the [[Ithullan]] to be a threat, prompting a crusade against their [[Ithull|world]]. The near [[Speciecide|extinction]] of the Ithullans did not sit well with all of the members of Aka'liit however, and was regarded as the beginning of the division that would lead to the split between the [[True Mandalorians]] and the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]].

The split within the Faithful was finally realized upon the choosing of [[Jaster Mereel]] as Mandalore, as his vision of the Mandalorians as merely highly paid soldiers, did not sit well with those who would become the Death Watch.
